EmailTemplate.subject: Action Needed to retain your access to valuable Intel confidential resources
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
We invite you to join our Intel Partner Alliance Program!
Act Now to Retain Your Access to Developer Zone
Join Intel Partner Alliance now
First Name: {!Contact.FirstName} Last Name: {!Contact.LastName} Username (Email Address):{!Contact.Email}
Act now to retain your exclusive access to the Intel Developer Zone Premier and unlock new benefits by joining Intel® Partner Alliance! Intel Partner Alliance membership access is now required to maintain your exclusive access to the Intel Developer Zone Premier, providing access to Intel’s Resource and Documentation Center, plus other NDA tools and resources for developers. When you join Intel Partner Alliance, you will gain access to other exclusive, highly valued benefits designed for partners and their employees. A few examples include:
Access to Intel Partner University, including badges that can be earned for completing competencies - curated training curriculum built around strategic focus areas, allowing you to build expertise in product, technology, and or business segment areas. Highly curated content focused on key industry topics such as Networking, Edge, AI, via the newly created Partner Activation Zones. Activation Zones are digital-first workspaces that curate critical resources and benefits - activating partners to build, market, and sell solutions based on Intel technology. Resources to expand your knowledge on Deep Learning, Machine Learning, and Generative AI and learn to navigate AI challenges using industry models tailored to data parameters through AI Everywhere pathways training.
Your company is already a valued member of Intel Partner Alliance. Join now by enrolling as a contact and you will earn 100 points¹ for your company and begin experiencing everything Intel Partner Alliance and Developer Zone Premier have to offer.
Follow these quick and easy steps:
Click Join Now and follow the prompts* to link you to your company’s account. Once confirmed you’ll receive an email to log into Intel Partner Alliance.
Don’t risk losing your access to the Intel Developer Zone - Join Intel Partner Alliance Now
Click to join
*Azure Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Help page - https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/articles/000092340/programs/access-entitlement-for-myintel-users.html?wapkw=azure%20mfa%20help
Need help signing up to be a partner? Contact support
¹Must be Points eligible to qualify. See eligibility requirements.
